text:
Harper (People Ops): Thanks for the great Qs in today's all-hands. Threading answers here so everyone has a written record. Post follow-ups and we'll update the FAQ.

Jo: When will managers communicate outcomes? Slide said "two-week window" but wasn't clear.

Harper (People Ops): Managers will notify individuals between Apr 12-19. If you don't hear by Apr 20, DM me and I'll escalate.

Eli (Eng): Clarify: if a promotion is approved but the manager misses the notice window, is the effective date retro?

Rina (Finance): Promotions approved in this cycle will have an effective pay date of Apr 1 for payroll purposes where possible. If a notice is late, People Ops + Finance will handle pro-ration/retro on a case-by-case basis.

Marco (Manager): Can managers submit late evidence if an engineer was traveling and we missed a doc deadline?

Harper (People Ops): Yes, late packets accepted with manager note explaining the reason. We do ask for all evidence by Apr 10 to make calibration smoother.

Leah: Any update on manager calibration training? Some new managers asked for a quick walkthrough.

Harper (People Ops): Running two 30-min calibration office hours next week (Mon 10am & Wed 4pm). Recording and a 1-pager cheat sheet will be posted after.

Jo: Appeals process reminder? Don't want people panicking without info.

Harper (People Ops): Appeals open for 14 days after notice. Send appeals@redwood.com with your packet and explanation. We triage within 5 business days.

people-ops-bot: Links: https://redwood.internal/hr/reviews-faq and the office hours calendar invite (posted in Events).

Harper (People Ops): If anything sensitive, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. We'll update this thread with the office hours recording and sample packets. Thanks everyone!
